text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see... In other words, Heart-san's 
charisma was inherited from her mother.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's right♪ Whenever Mom calls them, 
all her friends from her school days still 
gather together!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Our weekend house parties are absolute 
blowouts! My proud, number one mama in the 
whole wide world♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
......Um, if that's the case, my mother 
has also been well-loved for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Back in her active racing days, her honest 
and steady hard work truly touched the 
hearts of the fans. Even now, she still 
receives fan letters, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Well... Mom works hard behind the scenes 
too. She handles her work swiftly to make 
time to socialize, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My mother does too. In between her work at 
the racing club, she replies to fan 
letters one by one.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When I was young, she even made time to 
teach me my studies. Truly... she is a 
great mother.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's great!! What a wonderful person! 
Just like my mom!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san's mother sounds like such a 
respectable person, just like my own 
mother!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my gosh!! We're getting nowhere. Does 
this mean..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That just goes to show how wonderful our 
moms are! Now I really want to meet your 
mom too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I feel the exact same way. I would 
love the opportunity to introduce myself.
